messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PAGING - increased 5xx rate on /v1/generate (INC-2026-182)
Priya M.: noticed spike ~09:03 UTC, 15-20% 5xx across three hosts in eu-central-1. Latency up too.
Jonah R.: I'm oncall, starting triage. Any recent model promotions or routing changes?
Priya M.: no promotions since yesterday. Grafana shows KV cache eviction errors correlated with the spike. snippet:
```
[2026-03-25T09:03:12Z] pod=worker-9 model=redwood-large event=kv_evict_race err="failed CAS"
[2026-03-25T09:03:13Z] worker-10 status=500 route=/v1/generate msg="kv cache missing during fetch"
```
Ravi S.: taking lead for infra. Immediate mitigations: 1) reduce incoming batch sizes via ingress throttle 2) divert a small percentage of traffic to a cold pool 3) disable expensive prefetch.
Carla (Support): Support flagged 4 customers with errors; one enterprise (FinServe) reported timeouts and SLA concerns. AMs alerted.
Jonah R.: applying throttle: redwoodctl quota update --route /v1/generate --max-batch 16. Rolling now.
Priya M.: throttle applied across eu-central-1, average batch size down from 28 to 12, 5xx dropped to ~6% in 4m.
Sam (Platform): I'll open a routing rule to send 10% of requests to the eu-secondary-pool:
```
redwoodctl routing update --route /v1/generate --split '90:eu-central-1,10:eu-west-1'
```
Priya M.: split applied. error rate at 3% in 10m.
Ravi S.: for longer-term, hotfix candidate: add entry-level lock around cache eviction + sanitize stale entries. Spinning canary with lock enabled on 2 pods.
Jonah R.: canary metrics look good for 8m; no 5xx in canary. Proceed to promote after 15m stable.
Carla (Support): sent preliminary note to FinServe and a follow-up timeline. They want a postmortem and a contact.
Nia (Product): adding product-impact note: low-level SDK retries may amplify batch pressure; need to check client-side defaults.
Ravi S.: creating INC ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-182
Ravi S.: action items: 1) root fix - eviction lock (owner: Ravi) - due 2026-04-02 2) CI integration test for batch eviction under high rps - owner Priya - due 2026-03-30 3) routing circuit-breaker to auto-fallback to quantized variant when 5xx>8% - owner Sam - due 2026-04-10 4) customer outreach + timeline - owner Carla - due 2026-03-28
Jonah R.: will own postmortem doc and schedule a working session. Proposed review slot: 2026-04-01 15:00 UTC, 1hr.
Maya (SRE): taking oncall handoff at 10:20 UTC. Ping me if regression. :white_check_mark:
Priya M.: small note: added Grafana panels and alert rule for kv_evict_errors > 0.5% that pages infra.
Sam (Platform): prepping a 30-min brown-bag: "Routing Safeguards & Auto-Fallbacks" for 2026-04-08 11:00 PT. Will cover design and demo rules.
Nia (Product): I'll attend and bring SDK usage telemetry; we should discuss client retry defaults.
Carla (Support): drafting customer-facing post-incident summary. Will coordinate with AMs for FinServe 1:1.
Jonah R.: postmortem doc link: https://docs.redwood.com/postmortems/INC-2026-182 Will add timeline, RCA, and owners. Please add GH issues and tag incident-FY26.
Ravi S.: follow-up: add metric for batch-size percentile p95 to prod dashboard. Owner: Priya - due 2026-03-29
Jonah R.: thanks all — handing off oncall. Please append any missing actions here. We'll cover remediation progress in the postmortem session.
IncidentBot: INCIDENT RESOLVED at 09:47 UTC - error rate returned to baseline. Monitoring continues.
